remarks_1999: Whitney Archive indicates, "Exam. at Amer. Place, March 1946. ... No signature. Nothing on back. Very similar to 'Red Hills Grey Sky.'" Whitney Archive (American Art Research Council Questionnaires) indicates, "The picture is nailed to the wall, so it is impossible to examine back of picture or frame at this time." (Source: Lynes, 1999)

description: Reddish-brown hills lined with dark crags fill the composition. The hills sweep up from flat, pale-yellow earth. Above the hills, a bright blue sky with a single small, wispy cloud stretches across the canvas.
imageCaption: Image courtesy of a scanned transparency made for Georgia O'Keeffe: Catalogue Raisonné. This image has not been color proofed and may differ from the original. It will be replaced when newer photography becomes available.
